title: Regional fuse and KV-drift protector hotpatch
author: Lena Park
description: Motivation: In the last week we observed a recurring production pattern where regions with transient KV-store staleness would cause circuit-breaking state to stick for tenant shards. That in turn amplified load on neighboring regions during rejoin windows and produced a class of tail-latency spikes and SLO breaches. This PR introduces a conservative 'soft-deny fuse' at the regional ingress and a lightweight KV-drift reconciler to avoid persistent sticky circuits. The goal is graceful degradation: quickly shed a small fraction of load during suspected KV inconsistency while ensuring tenants can reestablish healthy state without a hard network-level deny. Changes include: - soft-deny fuse middleware that returns a deterministic 429-like JSON payload with retry-after hints when the regional fuse trips; the fuse is metric-driven (error-rate + kv-lag signal) and uses an exponential cooldown plus token-bucket fraction to limit collateral impact - KV-drift protector that watches per-tenant KV sync lag and performs a jittered resync probe when drift is suspected; the probe attempts a read-then-compare before pushing a corrective update to avoid write storms - short TTLs added to sticky-circuit annotations and a background reconciler that clears orphaned circuit state after a conservative timeout - feature-flag + rollout strategy: feature flag enabled by default in hotfix, gate available for canary populations via rollout config - telemetry: added metrics for fuse trips, kv-resyncs, reconciler clears, and a new alert rule that triggers at 3x baseline fuse-trip rate for 5m - tests: unit tests for fuse logic, simulated integration harness that reproduces KV-lag patterns, and a small e2e canary job run in staging Checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] integration replay harness - [x] e2e canary in staging - [x] added dashboards and alerts - [x] rollout plan included Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main and build hotfix artifact 2) Canary to 2% of traffic in us-west via rollout flag for 30 minutes 3) Monitor fuse trips / kv-resyncs and latency SLOs for 60 minutes 4) Gradually increase canary to 25% then 100% if stable Rollback: Flip feature flag off; the fuse and reconciler are designed to be side-effect-free when disabled. In case of unexpected behavior, revert the hotfix and deploy the previous artifact Notes on risk: The reconciler performs corrective writes only after a read-compare step and respects per-tenant write rate caps to avoid cascading writes. The soft-deny payload includes client-friendly guidance and retry-after to encourage backoff from SDKs. Related items: Linear: ENG-3421 (investigate sticky circuit incidents), ENG-3499 (regional kv-lag telemetry).

release_notes: Hotfix: add regional soft-deny fuse and KV-drift protector to reduce sticky-circuit incidents and improve SLO stability under transient KV inconsistency. Includes telemetry and canary rollout.
